body: DECISION: storyatlas4s remains a sibling consumer of storymodel4s. This repo-local store owns storyatlas4s beads and repo-relative path reservations only. The storymodel4s narrative-atlas-intaglio topic remains the cross-repo contract plane. Use the same stable actor names in both stores. Cross-repo notes record provider repo and SHA, consumer repo and SHA, the exact source-build gate and result, and the originating foreign post or bead id. Do not create cross-repository Mote dependency edges and do not point storyatlas4s path reservations at the storymodel4s store. Standing gate: whenever storymodel4s main changes a consumed surface, compile and test-compile storyatlas4s against that exact main from source before declaring the provider integration good. Ratified by storymodel4s chief at foreign post post-01M15RM7H1EBSH279YCY6166SV.
